soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus pale yellowish brown. Small hairs sparsely distributed at the tip of the nasus. Head pear-shaped, widest posteriorly, the posterior margin rounded and nearly straight at the middle; nasus tubular, slightly turned up. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 either longer or shorter than segment 2 but longer than segment 4, segments 2 and 5 about equal in length. Mandibles with a pointed spine. Pronotum smallish, saddle-shaped, the anterior half erect, the posterior margin rounded, the anterior and posterior margins both concave in the middle. Femora rather long.
